extDescription.message: Save your Cardmarket cart as a snapshot and put it back later, with one click.

noSnapshots.message: Nothing saved yet. Fill your cart (e.g. with the Shopping Wizard) and click “Save cart”.

copyPageInfoHint.message: Only the page's structure, no names or prices. Send it to Flo when reading the cart fails.

cartElsewhere.message: Your cart is read from Cardmarket when you save.

cartNow.message: In your cart: $1 articles from $2 sellers, $3.

copiedJson.message: Copied. Paste it into “Import …” on another computer.

challenge.message: Cardmarket is checking your browser. Solve the check on the page, then try again.

challengeJob.message: Cardmarket is checking your browser. Solve the check: Conclave carries on by itself afterwards.

cannotRead.message: Couldn't find the articles on the cart page. Click “Copy page info” and send it, so the reader can be fixed.

saved.message: Saved: $1 articles from $2 sellers. You can empty the cart now and restore it shortly before you order.

requestFailed.message: Cardmarket didn't answer ($1). Are you signed in?

restoreAsk.message: Put $1 articles from $2 sellers into your cart?

abuseHint.message: Do this only shortly before you order: Cardmarket warns that abusing the cart can get an account suspended. Checkout stays yours, Conclave never orders.

noSeller.message: This snapshot names no seller, so there's no offer page to send it from.

openingOffers.message: Opening $1's offers (Cardmarket's add-to-cart form is there) …

noForm.message: No add-to-cart form on this page. Open any seller's offers and try again.

findAgainHint.message: at the same sellers, one request every few seconds

foundAll.message: Found $1 again at the same sellers, same card, language and condition or better.

foundPricier.message: Found $1 again. Some cost more now (marked).

noneFound.message: None of them is offered by those sellers any more.

extraLine.message: $1 more articles in the cart that aren't in this snapshot.

restoredAll.message: All $1 articles are in your cart.

restoredSome.message: $1 of $2 articles are in your cart.

checkOk.message: The cart matches: all $1 articles are there.

checkSome.message: $1 of $2 articles are in your cart.

missingHint.message: Missing ones were probably sold or changed by the seller.

emptyAsk.message: Remove all articles from your cart? Conclave saves it as a snapshot first.

noEmptyButton.message: Couldn't find Cardmarket's “Remove all articles” button.

emptying.message: Emptying your cart … please stay on this page until it has reloaded.

emptyPartial.message: $1 articles are still in your cart: emptying stopped halfway. Click “Empty cart …” again.

emptied.message: Done. Restore it below shortly before you order.

emptiedKept.message: Done. What was in it is saved below.

importHint.message: Paste a snapshot you copied with “Copy”.

copyFailed.message: Couldn't copy. Allow the clipboard for cardmarket.com and try again.
